_doc: Per-file char budgets for instructions/memory files (GHI #373). AGENTS.md was tightened 40k→15k by OBPI-0.0.54-01 as a moderate-compromise target; OBPI-0.0.54-03 measured a ~31k transitional floor with the current monolithic template. The hard ceiling is Codex's 32768-byte project-doc cap: a per-turn budget above it would green-light a silently-truncated surface (enforced by tests.governance.test_agents_md_map_doctrine_obpi01/04 _budget_within_codex_cap). 2026-06-04: OBPI-0.0.37-26 LANDED the interim #519 relief — the local splice (.gzkit/agents.local.md) was hand-compressed 9,306→4,997 bytes, dropping rendered root AGENTS.md to 28,342 bytes, under this 30000 interim ceiling and ~4.4 KB under the Codex byte cap (genuine context reduction, not a budget-at-cap stopgap). This supersedes the transient budget-at-cap reading (32768) that only flipped the gate green without shrinking the surface. The committed rendition (renditions/agentcontract-codex-root-interim.md) is the durable payload OBPI-21/22's composer regenerates deterministically. The <15k destination remains GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37. CLAUDE.md 4000 and .claude/rules/*.md 15000 remain from OBPI-0.0.54.
